info.features: word 1-2gram TF-IDF + char_wb 2-5gram TF-IDF (fit on training split only)
info.task: SPAM detection on SMS (not general scam/fraud detection)
limitations: Trained on 2011-era UK/Singapore English SMS only: 'spam' (mostly promotions/premium-rate) is not the same as 'scam'. Banking/KYC/OTP/UPI phishing is outside the training data and is NOT reliably scored by the model - the rule-based cues exist to cover that gap.
Transactional notices (delivery/order/bank alerts) are neither personal chat nor promotional spam in the training data and receive middling scores -> often Unknown/Review.
Emails, job adverts, call transcripts and non-English text are a domain shift (handled by the Unknown/Review logic, not solved).
No Indian-context scam data (UPI/KYC/OTP) in the training set.

unknown_calibration.calibration: uncertain band = [2nd percentile of spam scores, 98th percentile of ham scores] over 5-fold out-of-fold predictions on train+val (class-overlap region); min_vocab_coverage = 1st percentile of validation word coverage. Scores are NOT calibrated probabilities.
